name: prebuilt/name-and-domain-to-email-waterfall-batch
displayName: Work Email CSV from Names and Domains
description: Resolve mailbox-verified work emails at each supplied company domain for a CSV of contacts with first name, last name, and company domain columns.

csv.description: Runtime CSV input path supplied through plays run --input, for example {"csv":"leads.csv"}.

columns.description: Optional CSV header aliases keyed by canonical play input field.

rows.description: Durable row dataset. Each row preserves the original CSV columns and adds an email column.

email.description: Resolved email address, or null if none was found.

email_source.description: Waterfall step that produced the resolved email.

email_validated.description: True when the final email passed validation before being returned.

staticPipeline.csvDescription: Load contact rows for work-email resolution.
staticPipeline.datasetDescription: Resolve a verified work email for each contact row.

stages.description: Load contact rows for work-email resolution.

stages.name: email_rows

steps.paramsSource:
{
      first_name: input.first_name,
      last_name: input.last_name,
      company_domain: input.domain,
      ...(input.linkedin_url ? { linkedin_url: input.linkedin_url } : {}),
      reveal_emails: true,
      reveal_phones: false,
    }

{
      first_name: input.first_name,
      last_name: input.last_name,
      company_domain: input.domain,
      ...(input.linkedin_url ? { linkedin_url: input.linkedin_url } : {}),
      include: ['work_email'],
    }
